_about: SAMA Cyber Security Framework -> Sentra SIEM evidence map. DRAFT: VERIFY WITH THE COMPLIANCE TEAM before it is used in front of SAMA or an auditor.

Control ids and titles are copied exactly from sentra-grcai/engine/catalogue.js (engine/compliance/sama-catalogue.js). Every catalogue control is listed here: either siem_evidenced=true with checks, or siem_evidenced=false (n/a for the SIEM, owned by GRC) with the reason.

Each check: {id, title, kind, params, on_fail: gap|partial, action}. kind is one of the evaluators in engine/compliance/sama.js (see 'kinds'). action is the recommended step that closes the check when it fails.

Status of a control = covered when every check passes; otherwise the worst on_fail of the failing checks (gap > partial). A check whose evidence is unavailable (e.g. ClickHouse down, no asset inventory) counts as partial, never as passing. max_status caps controls the SIEM can only partly evidence (the rest is GRC evidence).
Coverage % = (covered + 0.5 x partial) / number of SIEM-evidenced controls x 100.
Rules declare the controls they evidence in their own `sama` array (engine/detect/rules/*.json); rules_tagged checks count ENABLED rules carrying the control id.
Thresholds such as required retention and required source classes are admin settings (POST /api/soc/compliance/sama/settings); params here are defaults.

kinds.sources_active: configured or seen log sources that are not silent >= params.min
kinds.silent_sources: configured sources silent longer than their silent_after_s <= params.max
kinds.hosts_reporting: distinct hosts that sent events in the active window >= params.min
kinds.required_source_classes: every class in settings.required_source_classes has at least one reporting source/host
kinds.source_class: params.class has at least one reporting source/host
kinds.retention: effective hot retention (ClickHouse TTL, else config) >= settings.required_retention_days
kinds.detector_running: real-time detector loaded with rules and without rule load errors
kinds.rules_tagged: enabled rules tagged with this control >= params.min
kinds.rules_enabled: at least params.min of params.rules are enabled (default: all)
kinds.rule_topics: every topic in params.topics has at least one enabled rule; topics with no rule yet are listed with their action
kinds.alert_triage: alerts in the period: acknowledged-or-closed share >= params.min_ack_pct and average MTTA <= params.max_mtta_h
kinds.cases_handled: cases created or closed in the period >= params.min_cases
kinds.case_sla: case resolve-SLA compliance in the period >= params.min_resolve_pct
kinds.escalation: high/critical alerts (severity >= params.min_severity) escalated to a case or closed with a reason >= params.min_pct
kinds.intel_fresh: newest threat-intel list file is younger than params.max_age_days
kinds.ioc_matching: IOC-matching rules enabled (params.rules); reports IOC matches in the period
kinds.ad_sync: AD identity sync enabled, last run ok and younger than params.max_age_h
kinds.ueba: UEBA enabled and its detectors ran within params.max_age_h
kinds.asset_coverage: hosts reporting / known assets (config.enrich.assets + settings.known_assets / expected_asset_count) >= params.min_pct
kinds.vendor_accounts: third-party account patterns defined in settings.vendor_account_patterns

3.3.3.title: Asset Management
3.3.3.scope: The SIEM evidences which assets send security logs. The asset inventory itself (CMDB, ownership, classification) is GRC/IT evidence.

checks.title: Hosts reporting security events
checks.action: Onboard servers and network devices to the SIEM (WEF subscriptions, agents, syslog).

checks.title: Known assets reporting to the SIEM
checks.action: Load the asset inventory (config enrich.assets or settings known_assets / expected_asset_count) and onboard the assets that are not reporting.

3.3.4.title: Cyber Security Architecture
3.3.4.reason: Architecture design documents — owned by IT / GRC.

3.3.5.title: Identity & Access Management
3.3.5.scope: Monitoring of authentication, privileged access and account lifecycle events; AD identity context; behaviour analytics. Access approval and periodic access reviews are GRC/IAM evidence.

checks.title: Identity and access detections enabled
checks.action: Enable the SENTRA-AUTH / SENTRA-IAM / SENTRA-AD / SENTRA-CRED rule families.

checks.title: AD identity rules enabled
checks.action: Enable all SENTRA-AD-* rules (they need the AD identity sync).

checks.title: Privileged logon and privileged group monitoring
checks.action: Enable the privileged-access rules (SENTRA-AUTH-007, SENTRA-IAM-001, SENTRA-AD-003/004/005, SENTRA-LNX-002).

checks.title: Domain controller security logs collected
checks.action: Apply the sentra-dc WEF subscription to every domain controller (agents/wef/subscriptions/sentra-dc.xml).

checks.title: AD identity sync healthy
checks.action: Enable and fix the AD identity sync (sudo sentra-siem-ad status / sync-now; install/AD-IDENTITY.md).

checks.title: User behaviour analytics active
checks.action: Enable UEBA and check that its detectors run (GET /api/soc/ueba/health).

3.3.6.title: Application Security
3.3.6.scope: The SIEM evidences monitoring of application-layer attacks in web logs only. Secure development, testing and code review are GRC evidence.

checks.title: Web / application logs collected
checks.action: Forward web server / reverse proxy access logs (agents/linux/61-sentra-siem-webaccess.conf, IIS via relay).

checks.title: Application attack detections enabled
checks.action: Enable the SENTRA-WEB-* rules.

3.3.7.title: Change Management
3.3.7.scope: Detection of security-relevant configuration and account changes as an independent control over the change process. Change approval records (CAB) are GRC/ITSM evidence.

checks.title: Detections for security-relevant changes
checks.action: Add the missing change detections listed.

account_changes.title: Account and group changes
account_changes.action: Enable the SENTRA-IAM-* and SENTRA-AD-003/004 rules.

audit_policy.title: Audit policy changes
audit_policy.action: Enable SENTRA-ADC-006 (Windows 4719 auditing removed; 4719 is in the WEF sentra-dc / sentra-servers subscriptions). 4907 (auditing settings on an object changed) has no rule yet.

gpo_changes.title: Group Policy changes
gpo_changes.action: Enable SENTRA-ADC-002 (GPO linked / unlinked / enforced) and SENTRA-ADC-003 (GPO created / changed / deleted); they need 'Audit Directory Service Changes' on the domain controllers (5136/5137/5141 are in the sentra-dc WEF subscription). Set ad_changes.gpo_server for setting-level GPO change evidence.

checks.title: Domain controller change events collected
checks.action: Apply the sentra-dc WEF subscription to every domain controller.

3.3.8.scope: Firewall, network, malware and endpoint telemetry and the detections over it. Hardening baselines and network design are GRC/IT evidence.

checks.title: Firewall / network telemetry collected
checks.action: Forward FortiGate traffic, UTM and event logs (agents/network/README.md).

checks.title: Microsoft Defender telemetry collected
checks.action: Apply the sentra-defender WEF subscription (agents/wef/subscriptions/sentra-defender.xml) to servers and workstations.

checks.title: Infrastructure threat detections
checks.action: Add the missing infrastructure detections listed.

endpoint_defender.title: Defender detections
endpoint_defender.action: Add a rule on Defender events 1116 (malware detected) and 5001 (real-time protection disabled), both already in the sentra-defender WEF subscription.

3.3.14.title: Cyber Security Event Management
3.3.14.scope: Central log collection from the key source classes, retention, real-time detection and monitored alert triage.

checks.title: Active log sources
checks.action: Onboard log sources (WEF, agents, syslog, Microsoft 365).

checks.title: No silent log sources
checks.action: Restore the silent sources listed, or remove decommissioned ones from config.sources.

checks.title: Key source classes covered
checks.action: Onboard the missing source classes listed.

checks.title: Log retention meets the requirement
checks.action: Raise retention_days in /etc/sentra-siem/config.json (then restart to apply the ClickHouse TTL) or keep older data in the Data Optimizer archive tier.

checks.title: Real-time detection running
checks.action: Check the detector (GET /api/soc/detector/stats) and fix rule load errors.

checks.title: Event monitoring detections enabled
checks.action: Enable the detection rules tagged 3.3.14.

checks.title: Alerts triaged and acknowledged
checks.action: Acknowledge and triage open alerts; assign an on-shift analyst to the queue.

3.3.15.title: Cyber Security Incident Management
3.3.15.scope: Case handling, response playbooks, SLA and escalation of high-severity alerts. The incident response plan and SAMA notifications are GRC evidence.

checks.title: Incidents handled as cases
checks.action: Open cases for confirmed incidents (or record an incident exercise) so the process is evidenced in the period.

checks.title: Case resolution within SLA
checks.action: Work the cases breaching their resolve SLA; review the SLA targets with the SOC manager.

checks.title: Response playbooks available
checks.action: Add response playbooks for the main incident types.

checks.title: High-severity alerts escalated
checks.action: Escalate open high/critical alerts to cases or close them with a documented reason.

3.3.16.title: Threat Management
3.3.16.scope: Threat-intelligence enrichment and IOC matching in the SIEM. Intelligence sourcing and threat assessments are GRC evidence.

checks.title: Threat-intel indicators loaded
checks.action: Load IOC lists into the intel directory (<data>/intel/*.txt|csv).

checks.title: Threat-intel lists up to date
checks.action: Refresh the IOC lists at least weekly (automate the feed download).

checks.title: IOC matching rules enabled
checks.action: Enable the SENTRA-INTEL-* rules.

3.3.17.title: Vulnerability Management
3.3.17.scope: The SIEM detects exploitation attempts against known vulnerabilities. Scanning, patching and remediation tracking are not evidenced by the SIEM until scanner results are onboarded.

checks.title: Vulnerability scanner results onboarded
checks.action: Forward vulnerability scanner findings (e.g. Tenable/Nessus via syslog/CEF or API export) to the SIEM, then add a rule for critical findings on internet-facing hosts and correlate with IPS/web exploit alerts.

checks.title: Exploitation attempts detected
checks.action: Enable the exploit detections listed.
